The vertical axis is labeled as '% des BIP,' which refers to GDP (Bruttoinlandsprodukt), not GNP (Bruttosozialprodukt).

errors.evidence: In the left chart, total investments range from approximately 2% to 3% of GDP, not 2.5% to 3.5%.

errors.text_span: der Anteil der Gemeinden zwischen etwa 0,5 % und 1,5 % des BIP variiert
errors.evidence: The share of municipalities (Gemeinden) in the left chart ranges from approximately 1% to 2%, not 0.5% to 1.5%.
The description does not mention that the left chart represents gross fixed capital investments and the right chart represents net fixed capital investments.
The description does not mention the black line representing total investments of territorial authorities ('Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt').
The description does not mention the significant differences between gross and net investments, including the negative values in the net investment chart during certain years.
The description does not mention the vertical axis range (-0.5 to 3.5) or its unit (% of GDP).
The description does not mention the horizontal axis range (1991 to 2023) or the tick intervals (approximately five years).
